statement.zh: 巴达里文明及相关前王朝遗存（含 Caton-Thompson 赫马米耶工作）见 Brunton & Caton-Thompson 1928。
statement.en: Badarian civilisation and related Predynastic remains—including Caton-Thompson’s Hemamieh work—are documented in Brunton & Caton-Thompson 1928.
